description:
We are Team Nebula Nexus, building an interactive audio-visual web app that converts NASA Earth data and satellite images into real-time sound for The Earth Information 

Novochar is a full-stack, browser-based astronomy platform built around NASA's SPHEREx mission, originally developed as an entry for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge — "Planet X and SPHEREx." Its central idea is simple but demanding: let anyone see how the sky changes over time, while being rigorously honest about what the data
